summary: Show controller configuration, systemd state and actionable guidance in node status
details: Node status displays controller installation, template compatibility, runtime results and persistent autostart observations without changing node readiness.

Missing or outdated managed units receive explicit installation guidance that preserves supported timeout and image-pull settings; ordinary upgrades through the stable launcher do not require reinstallation.
Normal idle controllers and exit-code-2 requests for operator action are distinguished from failures, and custom systemd overrides require review instead of automatic replacement.
